# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1121
- **Deletions**: -227
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:08:34Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

🚨 **BLOCKING: the boot-time `saved` snapshot now re-renders over sanctioned mid-session config edits — settings-hub removals/global picks are silently reverted**

`persistConfig` now uses the boot-loaded `saved` as the copyWith base, and the emitter renders `agent:`, `auto_update:` and `compaction:` from it. But several settings-hub flows legitimately write `~/.fah/config.yaml` **directly, mid-session**, without updating `saved` (it is a `late final` loaded once at boot) or the fields this overlay carries. The next `persistConfig()` trigger in the same session (`/mode` switch, approval change, skill toggle, models/cube change…) re-renders the stale boot values over those edits. I verified both of these with a runnable repro against this branch:

1. **`_clearContextCap` (settings_flow.dart:2062) is undone.** Boot with `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` → settings → clear cap (drops the whole `agent:` block from the file, verified on disk) → any later persist → the file contains `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` again. Repro: reload after the next `saveCliConfig` returns `contextWindowCap == 256000`, expected `null`. Before this PR the removal stuck (the fresh-`CliConfig` emitter rendered no `agent:` section and `agent` was not in `_diskPreservedSections`).

2. **`_dropAutoUpdateKey` (settings_flow_auto_update.dart:44) is undone.** Boot with `auto_update: false` → settings → Auto update cycle off→notify (the key line is dropped, "notify is the default") → any later persist → the file contains `auto_update: false` again. Repro: reload returns `AutoUpdateMode.off`, expected `notify`.

3. **Global compaction picks are reverted the same way** (code-verified): settings → Compaction → scope **global** writes `compaction:\n  engine: …` via the sanctioned `_upsertConfigYaml`, but a later persist renders `compaction:` from `saved.compactionEngine` (the boot value) — and since the emitter rendered it, the backstop does not re-attach the newer block. Whenever the boot-loaded engine/judgeBudgetSeconds was non-default and differs from the pick (e.g. classic → structured, or a judgeBudget change), the user's global pick is overwritten. Pre-PR the emitter omitted `compaction:` and the backstop preserved the upsert-written block, so the pick survived. Note the new comment's claim — "a session/project selection cannot leak into the global file" — holds, but the inverse now happens: the global file's newer value is overwritten by the boot snapshot.

The `saved.copyWith` base is the right shape for the ticket's headline bug; the gap is that the boot snapshot can go stale against the three flows that mutate the global file outside `persistConfig`. Suggested directions (your pick):

- Overlay the live-maintained fields the same way `mode`/`approvalMode` are: `autoUpdate: cli.config.autoUpdate` fixes case 2 (the field is already mutated by the flow). Cases 1 and 3 need the snapshot refreshed, since `AgentCliConfig.contextWindowCap` is final and `liveCompactionEngine` must stay unpersisted (session scope promises no file change).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1121
- **Deletions**: -227
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:08:34Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

`persistConfig` now uses the boot-loaded `saved` as the copyWith base, and the emitter renders `agent:`, `auto_update:` and `compaction:` from it. But several settings-hub flows legitimately write `~/.fah/config.yaml` **directly, mid-session**, without updating `saved` (it is a `late final` loaded once at boot) or the fields this overlay carries. The next `persistConfig()` trigger in the same session (`/mode` switch, approval change, skill toggle, models/cube change…) re-renders the stale boot values over those edits. I verified both of these with a runnable repro against this branch:

1. **`_clearContextCap` (settings_flow.dart:2062) is undone.** Boot with `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` → settings → clear cap (drops the whole `agent:` block from the file, verified on disk) → any later persist → the file contains `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` again. 2. **`_dropAutoUpdateKey` (settings_flow_auto_update.dart:44) is undone.** Boot with `auto_update: false` → settings → Auto update cycle off→notify (the key line is dropped, "notify is the default") → any later persist → the file contains `auto_update: false` again. Pre-PR the emitter omitted `compaction:` and the backstop preserved the upsert-written block, so the pick survived. Note the new comment's claim — "a session/project selection cannot leak into the global file" — holds, but the inverse now happens: the global file's newer value is overwritten by the boot snapshot.

The `saved.copyWith` base is the right shape for the ticket's headline bug; the gap is that the boot snapshot can go stale against the three flows that mutate the global file outside `persistConfig`. Suggested directions (your pick):

- Overlay the live-maintained fields the same way `mode`/`approvalMode` are: `autoUpdate: cli.config.autoUpdate` fixes case 2 (the field is already mutated by the flow). Cases 1 and 3 need the snapshot refreshed, since `AgentCliConfig.contextWindowCap` is final and `liveCompactionEngine` must stay unpersisted (session scope promises no file change).

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1121
- **Deletions**: -227
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:08:34Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

`persistConfig` now uses the boot-loaded `saved` as the copyWith base, and the emitter renders `agent:`, `auto_update:` and `compaction:` from it. But several settings-hub flows legitimately write `~/.fah/config.yaml` **directly, mid-session**, without updating `saved` (it is a `late final` loaded once at boot) or the fields this overlay carries. The next `persistConfig()` trigger in the same session (`/mode` switch, approval change, skill toggle, models/cube change…) re-renders the stale boot values over those edits. I verified both of these with a runnable repro against this branch:

1. **`_clearContextCap` (settings_flow.dart:2062) is undone.** Boot with `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` → settings → clear cap (drops the whole `agent:` block from the file, verified on disk) → any later persist → the file contains `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` again. Repro: reload after the next `saveCliConfig` returns `contextWindowCap == 256000`, expected `null`. Before this PR the removal stuck (the fresh-`CliConfig` emitter rendered no `agent:` section and `agent` was not in `_diskPreservedSections`).

2. **`_dropAutoUpdateKey` (settings_flow_auto_update.dart:44) is undone.** Boot with `auto_update: false` → settings → Auto update cycle off→notify (the key line is dropped, "notify is the default") → any later persist → the file contains `auto_update: false` again. Repro: reload returns `AutoUpdateMode.off`, expected `notify`.

3. **Global compaction picks are reverted the same way** (code-verified): settings → Compaction → scope **global** writes `compaction:\n  engine: …` via the sanctioned `_upsertConfigYaml`, but a later persist renders `compaction:` from `saved.compactionEngine` (the boot value) — and since the emitter rendered it, the backstop does not re-attach the newer block. Whenever the boot-loaded engine/judgeBudgetSeconds was non-default and differs from the pick (e.g. classic → structured, or a judgeBudget change), the user's global pick is overwritten. Pre-PR the emitter omitted `compaction:` and the backstop preserved the upsert-written block, so the pick survived. Note the new comment's claim — "a session/project selection cannot leak into the global file" — holds, but the inverse now happens: the global file's newer value is overwritten by the boot snapshot.

The `saved.copyWith` base is the right shape for the ticket's headline bug; the gap is that the boot snapshot can go stale against the three flows that mutate the global file outside `persistConfig`. Suggested directions (your pick):

Cases 1 and 3 need the snapshot refreshed, since `AgentCliConfig.contextWindowCap` is final and `liveCompactionEngine` must stay unpersisted (session scope promises no file change).
- Cleaner general fix: make `saved` mutable and re-sync it (`saved = loadCliConfig(home)`) after every sanctioned direct file write (`_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, global/project `_upsertConfigYaml` wins, `_removeCapabilityYaml`) — via the existing hook pattern. Then every save renders the freshest on-disk truth and this whole class closes.

Please also add a regression test pinning "settings-hub removal/global write survives the next persist in the same session" (see the test-coverage comment).

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1121
- **Deletions**: -227
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:08:34Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1121
- **Deletions**: -227
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:08:34Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1121
- **Deletions**: -227
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:08:34Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

`persistConfig` now uses the boot-loaded `saved` as the copyWith base, and the emitter renders `agent:`, `auto_update:` and `compaction:` from it. But several settings-hub flows legitimately write `~/.fah/config.yaml` **directly, mid-session**, without updating `saved` (it is a `late final` loaded once at boot) or the fields this overlay carries. The next `persistConfig()` trigger in the same session (`/mode` switch, approval change, skill toggle, models/cube change…) re-renders the stale boot values over those edits. I verified both of these with a runnable repro against this branch:

1. **`_clearContextCap` (settings_flow.dart:2062) is undone.** Boot with `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` → settings → clear cap (drops the whole `agent:` block from the file, verified on disk) → any later persist → the file contains `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` again. Repro: reload after the next `saveCliConfig` returns `contextWindowCap == 256000`, expected `null`. 2. **`_dropAutoUpdateKey` (settings_flow_auto_update.dart:44) is undone.** Boot with `auto_update: false` → settings → Auto update cycle off→notify (the key line is dropped, "notify is the default") → any later persist → the file contains `auto_update: false` again. - Overlay the live-maintained fields the same way `mode`/`approvalMode` are: `autoUpdate: cli.config.autoUpdate` fixes case 2 (the field is already mutated by the flow). # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1121
- **Deletions**: -227
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:08:34Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

`persistConfig` now uses the boot-loaded `saved` as the copyWith base, and the emitter renders `agent:`, `auto_update:` and `compaction:` from it. But several settings-hub flows legitimately write `~/.fah/config.yaml` **directly, mid-session**, without updating `saved` (it is a `late final` loaded once at boot) or the fields this overlay carries. The next `persistConfig()` trigger in the same session (`/mode` switch, approval change, skill toggle, models/cube change…) re-renders the stale boot values over those edits. I verified both of these with a runnable repro against this branch:

1. **`_clearContextCap` (settings_flow.dart:2062) is undone.** Boot with `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` → settings → clear cap (drops the whole `agent:` block from the file, verified on disk) → any later persist → the file contains `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` again. Repro: reload after the next `saveCliConfig` returns `contextWindowCap == 256000`, expected `null`. Before this PR the removal stuck (the fresh-`CliConfig` emitter rendered no `agent:` section and `agent` was not in `_diskPreservedSections`).

2. **`_dropAutoUpdateKey` (settings_flow_auto_update.dart:44) is undone.** Boot with `auto_update: false` → settings → Auto update cycle off→notify (the key line is dropped, "notify is the default") → any later persist → the file contains `auto_update: false` again. Pre-PR the emitter omitted `compaction:` and the backstop preserved the upsert-written block, so the pick survived. Note the new comment's claim — "a session/project selection cannot leak into the global file" — holds, but the inverse now happens: the global file's newer value is overwritten by the boot snapshot.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1121
- **Deletions**: -227
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:08:34Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.

All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

`persistConfig` now uses the boot-loaded `saved` as the copyWith base, and the emitter renders `agent:`, `auto_update:` and `compaction:` from it. But several settings-hub flows legitimately write `~/.fah/config.yaml` **directly, mid-session**, without updating `saved` (it is a `late final` loaded once at boot) or the fields this overlay carries. The next `persistConfig()` trigger in the same session (`/mode` switch, approval change, skill toggle, models/cube change…) re-renders the stale boot values over those edits. I verified both of these with a runnable repro against this branch:

1. **`_clearContextCap` (settings_flow.dart:2062) is undone.** Boot with `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` → settings → clear cap (drops the whole `agent:` block from the file, verified on disk) → any later persist → the file contains `agent:\n  contextWindowCap: 256000` again. 2. **`_dropAutoUpdateKey` (settings_flow_auto_update.dart:44) is undone.** Boot with `auto_update: false` → settings → Auto update cycle off→notify (the key line is dropped, "notify is the default") → any later persist → the file contains `auto_update: false` again. Pre-PR the emitter omitted `compaction:` and the backstop preserved the upsert-written block, so the pick survived. Note the new comment's claim — "a session/project selection cannot leak into the global file" — holds, but the inverse now happens: the global file's newer value is overwritten by the boot snapshot.

The `saved.copyWith` base is the right shape for the ticket's headline bug; the gap is that the boot snapshot can go stale against the three flows that mutate the global file outside `persistConfig`. Suggested directions (your pick):

- Overlay the live-maintained fields the same way `mode`/`approvalMode` are: `autoUpdate: cli.config.autoUpdate` fixes case 2 (the field is already mutated by the flow). # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1587
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1587
- **Title**: gh-1572 [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1572` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 16
- **Additions**: +1121
- **Deletions**: -227
- **Created**: 2026-10-13T11:16:31Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:08:34Z

## PR Description

Closes #1572
### Root Cause

Starting `fa` rewrote `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` on every boot: the boot's `persistConfig` (`bin/fah_runapp.dart`) constructed a **new** `CliConfig(...)` passing only some fields, so every parsed section it did not mention (`spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, `power.hold`, `auto_update`) reset to defaults in the object being saved. Two cooperating leaks: `CliConfig.withCustomProviders` — the copy helper inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge-before-write — had drifted the same way (also dropping `spills`/`subagents`/`waiting`/`jobs`/`agentMode`/`misuseBreaker`/`streamThinking`), and the `_diskPreservedSections` disk backstop did not list the dropped keys, so nothing re-attached them from disk.

### Fix

- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart`:
  - complete `copyWith` (every parsed field, null = keep); `withCustomProviders` is now a `copyWith` delegation so the copy list can never drift again;
  - `toYaml()` renders `spills:` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml()`, non-defaults only) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`;
  - `_diskPreservedSections` extended to every known top-level key (`spills`, `subagents`, `waiting`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `power`, `auto_update`);
  - `saveCliConfig` skips the temp-file+rename when the merged output is byte-identical to the on-disk text — no write at boot when nothing changed.
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart`: `persistConfig` builds `saved.copyWith(<live session overlays only>)` — every section rides along from the loaded config by construction; the provider/model triple keeps the loaded seed (explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` still never change saved defaults). `compaction:` rides along as the loaded global value only — never the settings-hub live override or a project pick — so the documented no-leak guarantee holds.

### Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new, 6 tests): the ticket's config round-trips `loadCliConfig` → persist-shaped save → `saveCliConfig` with every section intact; the boot-shaped overlay save keeps the provider triple and every section; `toYaml` renders (and omits-at-defaults) `spills:`; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; an unchanged save does not rewrite the file (mtime pinned). All 6 failed before the fix, pass after.
- End-to-end (isolated `HOME`, the ticket's exact command): boot keeps every user section and renders `spills:`; a second boot performs no write (unchanged mtime).
- Full suite: ~4000 test groups green. The 19 failures in the local full run are all pre-existing environmental noise, each proven: 14 spawn-fa integration tests are hijacked by the runner's own `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` env (children reach a real provider instead of the mock) — they pass with the vars unset and fail identically on the base commit; the 5 `browser_ext` tests hit Chrome service-worker/D-Bus infra on this runner — the base commit fails the identical 5. No product-code regressions.

### Notes

- The first boot after this fix may canonicalize section order/formatting once (typed render of carried sections); content-equivalent, and subsequent boots with no change perform no write at all.
- `waiting:` still has no typed renderer — its raw on-disk block is the only faithful form and now survives saves via the backstop (same mechanism as `memory:`/`a2a:`).
- `compaction:` rides along from the LOADED global value only (never the settings-hub live override or a project pick), so the documented no-leak guarantee is unchanged.

# gh-1572: [BUG] fa boot rewrites ~/.fah/config.yaml and drops sections (spills, subagents, jobs, headless, agent, quota, tui, trajectory)

## Description

## Summary
Starting `fa` (verified on 1.0.565 and origin/main d5fd213d; first reported on 1.0.547) rewrites the global `~/.fah/config.yaml` from a freshly built `CliConfig` and silently loses user sections.

## Reproduction (isolated HOME)
```
mkdir -p /tmp/h/.fah
# config.yaml with: provider/model/baseUrl + spills, subagents, jobs, headless,
# agent (mode: pi), quota (badge: true), tui (theme: ohmypi-dark), trajectory (wireDump: true)
HOME=/tmp/h OPENAI_API_KEY=x fa --provider openai-completions --base-url http://127.0.0.1:1/v1 --model zzz -p x
```
Result: `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory` are gone; `mode: code`, `approvalMode: yolo`, `allowedTools: []` are added.

Note: in my run a plain `fa -p x` (no flags) and `fa --model zzz -p x` did the same, so the flags are not the only trigger. Any boot whose canonical rendering differs from the file rewrites it.

## Root cause (from code)
- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` (~1553-1625): `persistConfig` builds a NEW `CliConfig(...)` carrying only some fields (provider/model/baseUrl, mode, approval, roles, ttsr, customProviders, models, mcp, skills, cube, tools, memory, redact, a2a, providerTimeouts, images, fabric, power). It does NOT pass `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent` (`contextWindowCap`/`agentLoadMode`/`stuckTool`), `quota`, `tuiTheme`/`statusLine`, `wireDump`, `waiting`.
- `CliConfig.toYaml()` (`lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` ~944-1040) never renders `spills:`.
- The backstop `_diskPreservedSections` (~1664) does not list `spills`, `subagents`, `jobs`, `headless`, `agent`, `quota`, `tui`, `trajectory`, `waiting`, so they are not re-attached from disk.
- `persistConfig()` is also called unconditionally once at boot (~1627), so merely launching fa triggers the rewrite.

## Expected
- Saving never drops a known section: carry every parsed field through `persistConfig` (use `saved` as the base, e.g. a `copyWith`), render `spills:` in `toYaml`, and extend the disk-preservation backstop to all known top-level keys the caller did not render.
- Explicit per-launch flags (`--provider/--base-url/--model`) must not change the saved defaults (add a test to pin this).
- No write at boot when nothing changed.

## Regression tests
1. `saveCliConfig` round trip: a config.yaml with every known section survives `loadCliConfig` -> persistConfig-shaped `CliConfig` -> `saveCliConfig`.
2. `toYaml` renders `spills:` when set.
3. Boot with `--provider/--base-url/--model` leaves provider/model/baseUrl and all sections unchanged.

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The core gh-1572 fix is sound (`copyWith` base for the boot save is complete — 46/46 fields, `withCustomProviders` drift eliminated, backstop covers every known top-level key, `spills:` renders, unchanged saves skip the write; 6 new tests + the cli/config test groups pass). But the diff introduces two new correctness bugs, both reproduced against this branch, that must be fixed first.

**Key Issues**:
1. 🚨 BLOCKING — `persistConfig` renders from the stale boot-time `saved` snapshot, so sanctioned mid-session file writes are silently reverted: settings-hub "clear context cap" (`agent:` block resurrection) and "auto update off→notify" (`auto_update: false` re-added) verified by repro; global compaction picks reverted the same way when the boot value was non-default.
2. 🚨 BLOCKING — the emitter now writes `agent.misuseBreaker: false` but `validateAgentSection` (`fa config check`, `config set`, settings-hub upserts) rejects the key: `fa config check` false-fails on fa's own output and the harness-mode/cap settings flows refuse to save.
3. ⚠️ IMPORTANT — no regression tests pin either inverse invariant (removals survive the next persist; emitter output passes the validator).
4. 💡 SUGGESTION — unrelated `fetchLatestTag` reformat churn; 💡 the mtime no-op-save assertion can pass vacuously on coarse-clock filesystems.

**Next Steps**:
1. Refresh the save base after sanctioned direct file writes (re-sync `saved`, or overlay `cli.config.autoUpdate` + refresh on cap clear) and pin "removal survives the next persist" with a test.

3. Optionally drop the unrelated reformat hunk.
