# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

<<<<<<< HEAD
- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking
  inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge step); the `_diskPreservedSections`
  disk backstop covers every known top-level key. `spills:` renders in
  `toYaml` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`
  persists too; an unchanged save no longer rewrites the file at all.
  Rework round: the boot snapshot re-syncs from disk after every
  sanctioned mid-session settings write (`onUserConfigFileChanged` — a
  cleared context cap, an `auto_update` key drop or a global compaction
  pick is no longer resurrected/overwritten by the next save in the
  same session); `validateAgentSection` (the strict `fa config check` /
  `config set` / settings-hub mirror) accepts the emitter's
  `agent.misuseBreaker` and `agent.stuckTool` keys so `fa config check`
  never false-fails on fa's own output; clearing the context cap drops
  only the cap key instead of the whole `agent:` block (the sibling
  `mode:`/`misuseBreaker:` keys survive); and the `providersQueue:`
  block (no typed renderer) joins the disk backstop so a save can never
  silently delete the user's queue.
=======
- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always
  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for
  any empty shape (the exit-contract race is pinned by tests), and the
  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.
>>>>>>> origin/main

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.

- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
