# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.
- **BLOCKING 2 — `validateAgentSection` rejected the emitter's `agent.misuseBreaker: false`**: fixed in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — the mirror validator now knows `misuseBreaker` (boolean, mirroring `_parseAgentMisuseBreakerValue`) and `stuckTool` (validated with `StuckToolConfig.fromYaml`, the boot parser's own strict parser), so `fa config check` accepts a file `fa` itself wrote and the settings-hub agent upserts / `config set agent.*` save again.
- **IMPORTANT — unpinned regression classes**: covered by the tests below (removals survive the next persist; everything the emitter renders passes the validator).
- **Suggestion — reformat churn**: kept; reverting the `fetchLatestTag` wrap and running the repo's canonical `dart format` (Dart 3.13.5) re-wraps it into exactly the carried form — the hunk is formatter-mandated, not churn.
- **Suggestion — vacuous mtime pin**: strengthened; the no-op-save test now brackets the second save with a `Directory.watch` and asserts no `config.yaml.tmp.*` create/rename event fires (clock-independent), keeping the mtime + content assertions as the degraded-mode fallback.

## Files Modified

No new changes this pass (verification round). The rework head carries (`git diff origin/main`):

- `bin/fah_runapp.dart` — mutable `saved` + `onUserConfigFileChanged` re-sync; `persistConfig` is `saved.copyWith(<live overlays only>)`.
- `lib/src/cli/cli_config.dart` — complete `copyWith` (null = keep); `withCustomProviders` delegates to it; `toYaml` renders `spills:` and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`; `_diskPreservedSections` covers every known top-level key (incl. `providersQueue`); unchanged saves skip the temp-file+rename entirely.
- `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_config.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_config_sync.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_context_cap.dart` (new), `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_auto_update.dart`, `lib/src/cli/settings_flow_model_caps.dart`, `lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart` — the re-sync hook and its four fire sites; context-cap flow extracted for the repo's size gate.
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `validateAgentSection` gains `misuseBreaker` + `stuckTool`.
- `lib/src/spill/spill.dart` — `SpillsConfig.toYaml()` (non-defaults only).
- `CHANGELOG.md`, `memory/note/n_0997_fcdf.md` — release notes; rework contract note.
- Tests: `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` (new), `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart`, `test/config/config_service_test.dart`.

## Test Coverage

- `test/cli/config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart` — **12/12 green** on the final head: the ticket's full-section round-trip; boot-shaped overlay save pins the provider triple; `spills:` renders/omits at defaults; the disk backstop re-attaches every omitted block; the unchanged save performs no write (`Directory.watch` event pin); the sanctioned mid-session removals/picks (clear-cap, `auto_update` drop, global compaction pick) survive the next persist; the real `startAutoUpdateFlow` fires the re-sync hook; a `providersQueue` block survives a save the emitter cannot render.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — **77/77 green**, including the new emitter↔validator parity pins (`misuseBreaker`, `stuckTool`, and the mechanical "everything the agent emitter renders passes the strict mirror validator").
- `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` — sibling-agent-keys cap-clear pin green (in the full unit run below).
- Static gates: `dart analyze` — no issues in any PR-touched file (remaining infos are pre-existing in untouched files; the `office_addin/` analyzer errors are a separate unresolved package, untouched by this PR); `dart format --set-exit-if-changed` over all 14 touched files — 0 changed.
- Full suite on the final head (hijacking runner env `FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE`/`FA_LOG_FILE` unset):
  - Unit leg `dart test --exclude-tags integration`: **10,577 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failed**.
  - Integration leg `dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm`: **279 passed, 1 failed** — `header_badge_pty_test.dart` "a mid-run fold badges the status row until the turn settles" (the E1 `'hi!'` settle wait). **Proven pre-existing, not a PR regression**: an A/B worktree at the exact main commit this PR merged (`63d6eae32`) fails the identical test at the identical line with the identical `TimeoutException after 0:01:30.000000: Timed out waiting for "hi!" in output`. The test's own comments document this loaded-runner relief-chain class (gh-1469 budgets); the leg also hit a native `malloc_consolidate()` abort during the reporter summary (runner teardown, not a test failure — absent from the isolated re-runs).
- End-to-end (isolated HOME, the ticket's exact command, re-verified this pass): the boot keeps every user section — `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:` (`mode: pi` + `misuseBreaker: false`), `quota:`, `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `auto_update: false` — with the documented one-time canonicalization (the typed render fills section defaults, content-equivalent); explicit `--provider/--base-url/--model` leave the saved triple untouched; a second boot with nothing changed performs **no write** (byte-identical file, identical mtime).

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

# gh-1572 rework — verification pass: all three open review threads confirmed fixed on head `69499c0d`

## Issues/Notes

- The three open threads trace to one automated review (2 🚨 BLOCKING, 1 ⚠️ IMPORTANT, 2 💡 suggestions). This pass verified each fix in the tree and re-ran the red-first regression tests green on the final head. No new code defects surfaced; no code changes were needed this round beyond what the rework round landed.
- Scope check for BLOCKING 1 ("stale snapshot resurrects a sanctioned write"): swept every direct `~/.fah/config.yaml` write path in `lib/src/cli/`. The four sanctioned flows the review listed all fire the new re-sync hook. The remaining direct writers (`_writeTtsrSection`, `_writeMcpSection`) render the same boot-carried values on `main` (the pre-PR `persistConfig` also passed `ttsr: saved.ttsr` and `mcp`), so their behavior is unchanged by this PR and outside the flagged threads; `_writeDapHubOptOut` targets `<cwd>/.fah/packages.yaml`, not the user config.
- CI on the rework head: no failed checks (`ci_failures.md` reports all green).

## Approach

- **BLOCKING 1 — stale boot snapshot re-rendered over sanctioned mid-session writes**: fixed by the `AgentCliConfig.onUserConfigFileChanged` hook, fired (awaited) after every sanctioned USER-file direct write — `_upsertConfigYaml` user-scope wins (global compaction picks, harness-mode/context-cap upserts, provider timeouts, images, memory stores, `auto_update` upserts, model-capability upserts), `_clearContextCap`, `_dropAutoUpdateKey`, `_removeCapabilityYaml` (shared helper `_notifyUserConfigFileChanged` in `settings_flow_config_sync.dart`). `bin/fah_runapp.dart` re-syncs `saved = loadCliConfig(home)` with a `ConfigException` guard that keeps the previous snapshot. `_clearContextCap` is additionally a surgical `removeYamlPath(['agent', 'contextWindowCap'])` so sibling `agent:` keys survive a cap clear.

bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

Senior Developer Engineer focused on code fixes You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Coding Guidelines — follow existing codebase patterns and conventions"] G2["Before implementing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists in project root or subdirectories → READ and FOLLOW it — it contains agent-specific instructions, coding styles, and conventions"] G4["If skills are available in the project → USE them — they provide specialized capabilities, workflows, and tool integrations"] G5["Instructions may be extended via project configuration — always follow the full set of provided instructions"] G6["Never invent new patterns when the codebase already has an established way of doing things"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 --> G5 --> G6 ``` ```mermaid flowchart TD START([Ticket enters rework]) --> SETUP{rework_setup_failed.md exists?} SETUP -->|Yes| FAIL[Write setup failure response and stop] SETUP -->|No| INPUT[Read ALL input files in the ticket subfolder] INPUT --> INPUTS["request.md, comments.md, existing_questions.json, parent_context_*.md, pr_info.md, pr_diff.txt, merge_conflicts.md, ci_failures.md, ci_failures_full.log, review_state.md, pr_discussions.md, pr_discussions_raw.json"] INPUTS --> CONFLICTS{merge_conflicts.md exists?} CONFLICTS -->|Yes| RESOLVE["Resolve every conflict marker, git add each file, verify with git diff --check"] CONFLICTS -->|No| CI RESOLVE --> CI{ci_failures.md or ci_failures_full.log exists?} CI -->|Yes| FIX_CI["Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup"] CI -->|No| THREADS FIX_CI --> THREADS[Address every open thread in pr_discussions.md] THREADS --> BLOCKING{BLOCKING issues?} BLOCKING -->|Yes| FIX_BLOCK["Fix BLOCKING first — security, critical bugs"] FIX_BLOCK --> IMPORTANT BLOCKING -->|No| IMPORTANT[Fix IMPORTANT issues] IMPORTANT --> SUGGESTIONS{Minor suggestions?} SUGGESTIONS -->|Yes| SKIP["Skip if time-consuming — note in response.md"] SUGGESTIONS -->|No| TEST["Follow TDD approach for every fix — see tdd_approach.md — then run tests and verify"] SKIP --> TEST TEST --> OUTPUT[Write outputs/response.md] OUTPUT --> REPLIES{Open review threads?} REPLIES -->|Yes| REVIEW_REPLIES["Write outputs/review_replies.json with one reply per open thread using threadId + inReplyToId"] REPLIES -->|No| END([End]) REVIEW_REPLIES --> END ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/review_state.md — reviewer verdict + decision state (CHANGES_REQUESTED = blocking)"] P7["7️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 --> P7 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph TDD["TDD for PR Rework — RED-GREEN-REFACTOR"] T0["Start from the concrete issue: a CI failure, a review thread, or a BLOCKING/IMPORTANT finding"] T1["RED: Write or extend a test that REPRODUCES the reported issue
— must fail before the fix

blocks.text:
# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi

          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1

          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.

            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

<<<<<<< HEAD
- fix(cli): gh-1572 — `fa` boot no longer rewrites `~/.fah/config.yaml`
  from a lossy config. `persistConfig` (bin/fah_runapp.dart) built a
  fresh `CliConfig` carrying only some fields and `persistConfig()` ran
  unconditionally at boot, so every launch silently dropped the user's
  `spills:`, `subagents:`, `jobs:`, `headless:`, `agent:`, `quota:`,
  `tui:`, `trajectory:`, `waiting:`, `power.hold` and `auto_update`
  settings (first reported on 1.0.547). Three cooperating fixes: the
  boot save is now `saved.copyWith(<live overlays>)` so every parsed
  section rides along by construction; `CliConfig.copyWith` replaces the
  drifted hand-rolled `withCustomProviders` field list (itself dropping
  spills/subagents/waiting/jobs/agentMode/misuseBreaker/streamThinking
  inside `saveCliConfig`'s merge step); the `_diskPreservedSections`
  disk backstop covers every known top-level key. `spills:` renders in
  `toYaml` (new `SpillsConfig.toYaml`) and `agent.misuseBreaker: false`
  persists too; an unchanged save no longer rewrites the file at all.
  Rework round: the boot snapshot re-syncs from disk after every
  sanctioned mid-session settings write (`onUserConfigFileChanged` — a
  cleared context cap, an `auto_update` key drop or a global compaction
  pick is no longer resurrected/overwritten by the next save in the
  same session); `validateAgentSection` (the strict `fa config check` /
  `config set` / settings-hub mirror) accepts the emitter's
  `agent.misuseBreaker` and `agent.stuckTool` keys so `fa config check`
  never false-fails on fa's own output; clearing the context cap drops
  only the cap key instead of the whole `agent:` block (the sibling
  `mode:`/`misuseBreaker:` keys survive); and the `providersQueue:`
  block (no typed renderer) joins the disk backstop so a save can never
  silently delete the user's queue.
=======
- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)

blocks.text:
# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1

          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.

          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"

publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the

      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

blocks.text:
# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

Interesting — `crap4dart check --baseline` PASSES locally?! "Gates: 3 passed, 1 warned, 21 skipped". The CRAP gate seems to be among the "skipped" or needs coverage data. CRAP = Change Risk Analysis and Predictions — it's coverage-driven: CRAP = comp² × (1 - coverage)² + comp. The CI's failing job needs the coverage run first (`dart test --coverage` then the crap analyze with coverage). The reviewer said "at ~95% coverage the complexity-13 function lands at CRAP 13.02". Locally without coverage data, the gate skips the CRAP check ("21 skipped").

So local red-reproduction of the CRAP gate needs a coverage run — expensive. The reviewer already reproduced it and quoted the CI line:
```
13.02   95.0  N/A   13  (top-level).validateAgentSection   lib/src/config_service.dart:1290
Max CRAP: 13.02 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)
```

RED evidence for Fix A: the CI failure itself (input ci_failures.md + thread 6's log quotes). I can also verify the complexity claim statically: `dart pub global run crap4dart analyze` (without coverage) reports complexity per function — let me get validateAgentSection's complexity from that (comp 13? The CI table showed "13" as complexity? The row: `13.02 95.0 N/A 13` — columns are crap, coverage%, ?, complexity. comp=13, coverage 95 → CRAP = 13²×(1−0.95)² + 13 = 169×0.0025+13 = 0.42+13 = 13.42... hmm ≈ 13.02 means comp=12? 12²×0.0025+12 = 0.36+12 = 12.36. Or comp=13 with cov 95.3: 169×(0.047)²=0.373+13=13.37. Whatever — comp 13 at 95% coverage → 13.02... maybe their formula: comp×(1-cov)²+comp = 13×0.0025+13 = 13.03 ≈ 13.02. Yes! CRAP = comp × (1−cov)² + comp (not comp²). So comp 13, cov 95.0 → 13×0.0025+13 = 13.0325 ≈ 13.02 (their cov was 95.15 or so).

To get under 12.0: with coverage ~95%, comp must be ≤ 11 (11×0.0025+11 = 11.03 ✓). Complexity 13 → need ≤ 12 decision points... The reviewer's fix shape 1 (validator map) reduces the switch function's complexity to ~3-4. That's the cleanest.

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on

      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard

CRAP = Change Risk Analysis and Predictions — it's coverage-driven: CRAP = comp² × (1 - coverage)² + comp. The CI's failing job needs the coverage run first (`dart test --coverage` then the crap analyze with coverage). The reviewer said "at ~95% coverage the complexity-13 function lands at CRAP 13.02". Locally without coverage data, the gate skips the CRAP check ("21 skipped").

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do

          done
