# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

The existing tests drive the real flows with the `settings_flow_test` harness (`cliFor` + `render` + `io.sendLine` + `waitForIt`). That harness lives in `test/cli/settings_flow_test.dart` (its own helpers) — the reg test file uses a different lighter harness (`agent_cli_test_support.dart`'s bootCli + FakeCliIO with `sendLine`?).

Given the complexity of driving the full interactive flows in the reg file, the pragmatic RED-first approach for Fix B:

**Reg tests (in config_section_preservation_reg_test.dart, new group or extend existing group):**
1. "the ttsr rules edit is not resurrected" — mimic-shape write (replace the `ttsr:` block the way `_writeTtsrSection` lands it via `_replaceTopLevelYamlBlock`... that's private too). Mimic with plain text manipulation: seed a `ttsr:` block, boot snapshot, apply the flow-shaped edit (string-replace the ttsr block), then `persistShapedSave(bootSnapshot)` → expect the edit survived. This is RED today (the save re-renders `ttsr:` from the stale snapshot... wait — does it? `saved.ttsr` non-null → emitter renders the BOOT ttsr block → the edited block is overwritten. Yes RED).

Hold on — wait. Actually let me re-check: does the backstop preserve the newer disk ttsr block? `_preserveDiskSections(diskText, emitted)`: for 'ttsr' — if the EMITTED text has a top-level ttsr block (it does — the boot value's block), the backstop skips re-attaching the disk (newer) block. So the flow's edit is lost. RED confirmed conceptually.

2. Same for mcp.

But a mimic-shape test doesn't exercise the HOOK (the fix) — it would stay RED even after wiring the hook into the flows, because the mimic never calls the flow. That's the trap: my reg test must go through the REAL flow method for the fix to turn it green.

So the tests must drive `startTtsrRulesFlow`/`startMcpServersFlow` for real. The reg file's `bootCli` uses FakeCliIO whose `lines` stream feeds `_askLine`/menus? Menu flows use `_pickOption` which reads from io.lines? In settings_flow_test they use `io.sendLine` — FakeCliIO must support sendLine. Let me check FakeCliIO.sendLine + the reg test's bootCli FakeCliIO (same class from agent_cli_test_support.dart). Yes — FakeCliIO has sendLine presumably.

Driving the flows:
- TTSR: seed a `ttsr:` block with one rule (disabled), boot, then: `startTtsrRulesFlow()` → menu (1=no-secrets...) → sendLine('1') (rule submenu) → sendLine('1') (toggle) → wait for 'ttsr saved' → sendLine('4') (done). Then persistShapedSave(snapshot) with hook-wired snapshot re-sync, then assert the toggled rule survived.
- MCP: seed an `mcp:` block with a stdio server, flow: menu → sendLine('1') (fs server submenu) → sendLine('1') (edit) → command prompt → sendLine('node2') → args → env → wait 'mcp saved' → sendLine('4') done.

Hmm — but the reg test's bootCli creates AgentCli with `streamFunction: FakeStreamFunction(...)` and no `cli.run()`? In settings_flow_test, flows run within `cli.run()` context (the run loop processes io lines?). Actually `startTtsrRulesFlow()` is awaited directly; `_pickOption` renders and awaits io.lines. The `render(1)` helper waits for N renders. The reg test's bootCli returns (cli, io) with FakeCliIO — the flows can be driven the same way (sendLine into the lines stream). The `waitForIt`/`render` helpers are defined in settings_flow_test.dart — I'd need to reimplement small versions in the reg file (poll io.out for a marker with timeout).

This is doable but heavy. Alternative lighter-but-real path: call the flows with a scripted FakeStreamFunction? No — flows read io lines, not the stream function.

OK — but hold on. Is there an existing simpler seam: `_writeTtsrSection` fires via `startTtsrRulesFlow` only. What about pinning the hook at the `_writeTtsrSection` level — the function is private, but same-library tests could... no, tests are separate libraries.

Decision: drive the real flows in the reg file with a small local render/wait helper. Both flows' pick sequences are pinned by existing settings_flow tests, so I know the exact input scripts. I need to match the menu numbering by reading the menu builders.

Actually — WAIT. Simpler idea for a REAL-path test: `startMcpServersFlow`'s DELETE branch (fewer prompts: menu → pick server → confirm 'y') or the TTSR toggle (menu → '1' → '1'). Both are 2-3 sendLines. Let me read the exact menus:

- startTtsrRulesFlow main menu: rules listed 1..N, then 'add', 'done' — from the AC2 test: `io.sendLine('1'); // no-secrets` → rule submenu → `io.sendLine('1'); // toggle`. Then `'4'); // done (1=no-secrets, 2=no-french, 3=add, 4=done)`.
- startMcpServersFlow main menu: `1=fs, 2=remote, 3=add, 4=done` → server submenu: `1=edit, 2=delete, 3=back`(?) then edit prompts command/args/env.

I'll replicate exactly what the existing tests do (they're proven scripts). For the reg file I need:
- seed with ttsr/mcp sections (reg ticketConfigYaml has neither — add in-test).
- bootCli already exists; extend it? bootCli config has no ttsr-specific seeding needs (flows read the file via _env).
- drive, hook fires, assert.

The RED check: before wiring, the flow write succeeds but the hook doesn't fire → in the "survives the persist" shape, the persist clobbers → assertions fail. Also a hook-count assertion (`resyncs, 1`) fails directly — that's the cleanest RED.

Then GREEN: add `await _notifyUserConfigFileChanged()` in `_writeTtsrSection` (only when path is the user config!) and `_writeMcpSection` (same guard). Check: can `_writeTtsrSection`/`_writeMcpSection` write a project path? ttsr flow: scope menu 'global' → `_userConfigPath()`; the rules flow may be project-scoped? Let me check startTtsrRulesFlow's path selection. Earlier grep showed line 462 scope menu ('global' → _userConfigPath ?? unavailable; 'project' → project path) — that was for ttsr? Let me verify both flows' path sources.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

Interesting — `crap4dart check --baseline` PASSES locally?! "Gates: 3 passed, 1 warned, 21 skipped". The CRAP gate seems to be among the "skipped" or needs coverage data. CRAP = Change Risk Analysis and Predictions — it's coverage-driven: CRAP = comp² × (1 - coverage)² + comp. The CI's failing job needs the coverage run first (`dart test --coverage` then the crap analyze with coverage). The reviewer said "at ~95% coverage the complexity-13 function lands at CRAP 13.02". Locally without coverage data, the gate skips the CRAP check ("21 skipped").

So local red-reproduction of the CRAP gate needs a coverage run — expensive. The reviewer already reproduced it and quoted the CI line:
```
13.02   95.0  N/A   13  (top-level).validateAgentSection   lib/src/config_service.dart:1290
Max CRAP: 13.02 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)
```

I can also verify the complexity claim statically: `dart pub global run crap4dart analyze` (without coverage) reports complexity per function — let me get validateAgentSection's complexity from that (comp 13? The CI table showed "13" as complexity? The row: `13.02 95.0 N/A 13` — columns are crap, coverage%, ?, complexity. comp=13, coverage 95 → CRAP = 13²×(1−0.95)² + 13 = 169×0.0025+13 = 0.42+13 = 13.42... hmm ≈ 13.02 means comp=12? 12²×0.0025+12 = 0.36+12 = 12.36. Or comp=13 with cov 95.3: 169×(0.047)²=0.373+13=13.37. Whatever — comp 13 at 95% coverage → 13.02... maybe their formula: comp×(1-cov)²+comp = 13×0.0025+13 = 13.03 ≈ 13.02. Yes! CRAP = comp × (1−cov)² + comp (not comp²). So comp 13, cov 95.0 → 13×0.0025+13 = 13.0325 ≈ 13.02 (their cov was 95.15 or so).

      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1

          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.

          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }

          done

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the

      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"

            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the

      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

blocks.text:
# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml
      # threshold (they drifted to 8.0-vs-12.0 once). Pure python — runs on
      # every PR, including docs-only ones (a README edit is exactly the
      # drift vector).
      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard
        run: python3 scripts/check_crap_guards.py

Interesting — `crap4dart check --baseline` PASSES locally?! "Gates: 3 passed, 1 warned, 21 skipped". The CRAP gate seems to be among the "skipped" or needs coverage data. CRAP = Change Risk Analysis and Predictions — it's coverage-driven: CRAP = comp² × (1 - coverage)² + comp. The CI's failing job needs the coverage run first (`dart test --coverage` then the crap analyze with coverage). The reviewer said "at ~95% coverage the complexity-13 function lands at CRAP 13.02". Locally without coverage data, the gate skips the CRAP check ("21 skipped").

So local red-reproduction of the CRAP gate needs a coverage run — expensive. The reviewer already reproduced it and quoted the CI line:
```

Max CRAP: 13.02 — FAIL (threshold: 12.00)
```

RED evidence for Fix A: the CI failure itself (input ci_failures.md + thread 6's log quotes). I can also verify the complexity claim statically: `dart pub global run crap4dart analyze` (without coverage) reports complexity per function — let me get validateAgentSection's complexity from that (comp 13? The CI table showed "13" as complexity? The row: `13.02 95.0 N/A 13` — columns are crap, coverage%, ?, complexity. comp=13, coverage 95 → CRAP = 13²×(1−0.95)² + 13 = 169×0.0025+13 = 0.42+13 = 13.42... hmm ≈ 13.02 means comp=12? 12²×0.0025+12 = 0.36+12 = 12.36. Or comp=13 with cov 95.3: 169×(0.047)²=0.373+13=13.37. Whatever — comp 13 at 95% coverage → 13.02... maybe their formula: comp×(1-cov)²+comp = 13×0.0025+13 = 13.03 ≈ 13.02. Yes! CRAP = comp × (1−cov)² + comp (not comp²). So comp 13, cov 95.0 → 13×0.0025+13 = 13.0325 ≈ 13.02 (their cov was 95.15 or so).

To get under 12.0: with coverage ~95%, comp must be ≤ 11 (11×0.0025+11 = 11.03 ✓). Complexity 13 → need ≤ 12 decision points... The reviewer's fix shape 1 (validator map) reduces the switch function's complexity to ~3-4. That's the cleanest.

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

      # Issue #433 AC1: README CRAP badge must equal the crap4dart.yaml

      - name: CRAP badge/config sync guard

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done

And then it timed out at line 569 — which is `waitRenders(io, 2)` after sending '1'. So sendLine('1') didn't advance the flow. Why? The picker prompt appeared... The `render` counting: 'type a number:' appeared ONCE. waitRenders(io, 1) passed. Then `io.sendLine('1')` → the line goes to `_lines` controller. But the picker's `_promptLine` may have started listening AFTER... no — the prompt printed before my sendLine (waitRenders(io,1) succeeded after the prompt was printed). Unless the FIRST 'type a number:' was printed during waitRenders(1) and my sendLine raced BEFORE `_promptLine` subscribed to io.lines. `_promptLine` prints 'type a number: ' THEN awaits the line — there's an await gap between print and listen. My waitRenders polls every 10ms — it could observe the prompt before the listener attached, send '1' into the broadcast controller with no listener → line dropped → hang. The settings_flow_test uses `render(n)` (same race!) — but they also run `cli.run()` concurrently which may prime things... Actually StreamController here is a plain broadcast? `final _lines = StreamController<String>();` — NOT broadcast — a single-listener controller buffers events until listened! So an early sendLine would be buffered and delivered once `_promptLine` listens. That's not the issue then...

Wait — is the FIRST sendLine consumed by something else? Hmm: `bootCli` never runs `cli.run()`. In settings_flow_test, `cli.run()` is active. Maybe `_promptLine` (line 50ish) uses `_pendingPromptAnswer` mechanism wired through the run loop?! Look: `_promptLine` at provider_flow_helpers.dart:~50: it creates a `pending` Completer, listens to io.interrupts... and the actual line reading — maybe via `io.lines` with a subscription stored on the CLI (`_attachLineFeed`?) that only exists when run() is active. The `_pendingPromptAnswer` field suggests the run loop feeds prompts: run() listens to io.lines and completes `_pendingPromptAnswer`. Without run(), nobody completes the pending → hang with the menu rendered. That matches the observed state: menu printed, prompt printed, sendLine buffered but never consumed.

Fix the test harness: run `cli.run()` concurrently like settings_flow_test does — with FakeStreamFunction and sendLine('/exit') + `await run` at the end. bootCli returns (cli, io); I'll mirror the settings_flow_test pattern:

final (cli, io) = bootCli(onUserConfigFileChanged: ...);
final run = cli.run();
... drive ...
await flow;
io.sendLine('/exit');
await run;
```

# recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          echo '<html></html>' > "$d/build/index.html"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad2.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an unpatchable base tag (AC1 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 3: a missing touchpoint file.
          rm "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad3.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed an incomplete build (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # fa1.dev parity pin: both web builds must keep the identical
          # release flags AND the same pinned SDK — the bundle's only edit
          # stays the base tag. (#1431): the SDK pin must be an EXACT
          # 3.47.x patch (no wildcard) — a floating patch re-resolves a new
          # engine build and moves the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the
          # size gates track.
          for wf in .github/workflows/pages.yml .github/workflows/ci.yml; do
            grep -q -- '--release' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost the --release web flag (#1100 parity)"; exit 1; }
            grep -q -- '--base-href /app/' "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf lost --base-href /app/ (#1100 parity, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
            grep -Eq "flutter-version: '3\.47\.[0-9]+'" "$wf" || { echo "::error::$wf unpinned Flutter SDK (#1100 parity + #1431 exact-patch rule, pages + bundle must share it)"; exit 1; }
          done
